hook.description: A wide shot of Juliana kneeling in the ruins of her garden while Alexander stands over her with a heavy hammer.
hook.evidence: The visual contrast between the vulnerable woman and the protective, armed man immediately establishes the stakes of the aftermath.

candidates.reason: This moment captures the core dynamic of the show: a protector vowing to keep his wife safe against impossible odds.

hook.description: Juliana looking up at Alexander in the warm, intimate glow of the hearth.
hook.evidence: The shift from the brutal garden to the tender, romantic atmosphere of the cottage creates an immediate emotional hook.

candidates.reason: It highlights the growing intimacy and vulnerability between the two leads, pulling viewers into their developing romance.

hook.description: Juliana reaching out to touch Alexander's beard with her bandaged hand.
hook.evidence: The visual of the bandaged hand against his rugged face emphasizes their shared trauma and growing bond.

candidates.reason: The dialogue about not knowing the man she married creates a compelling mystery that encourages viewers to watch the full series.
